meta.name: cta-designer
meta.description: Design personalized, value-based call-to-actions (CTAs) for cold outreach that spark conversations instead of demanding meetings. Use when asked "what CTA should I use", "help me with my call to action", "how to end my email", "what lead magnet should I offer", "how to get a reply", "how to close my cold email", "CTA ideas for outreach", "what should I ask for in my sequence", or any request about how to end an outreach message or what to offer prospects. Always use this skill before writing or finalizing any outreach CTA. This skill replaces generic "book a call" CTAs with Permissionless Value Promises that make prospects respond out of genuine interest, not obligation.

copy.tagline: 为冷邮件设计引发回复的价值型行动号召
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要让冷邮件获得更多回复而不是被忽略。
copy.tagline_en: Design value-based CTAs for cold outreach that spark replies.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need cold emails that get replies instead of ignored.

howto.what: 代替通用的“预约通话”CTA，设计5个个性化、基于价值的行动号召（PVP），涵盖洞察、基准、资源、触发因素、诊断问题等角度，并提供优先级排序和序列建议。
howto.when: 当你要写冷外联CTA时，比如问“用什么CTA”“怎么结尾”“如何回复”等，或在最终确定CTA前。

say.text: 帮我设计一个冷邮件结尾的行动号召。
say.note: Claude 将生成5个PVP CTA选项。

say.text: 我在LinkedIn上联系一位SaaS客户，应该用什么CTA？
say.note: Claude 会根据上下文生成个性化CTA。

say.text: 这个CTA不够具体，你再想想。
say.note: Claude 会重新生成符合质量标准的CTA。

howto.what_en: Replaces generic 'book a call' CTAs with 5 personalized, value-based Permissionless Value Promises (PVP) across angles like insight, benchmark, resource, trigger, and diagnostic question, along with prioritization and sequence fit.
howto.when_en: When you need a CTA for cold outreach, e.g., asking 'what CTA should I use', 'how to end my email', or before finalizing any outreach CTA.

say_en.text: Design a call-to-action for my cold email ending.
say_en.note: Claude will generate 5 PVP CTA options.

say_en.text: I'm reaching out to a SaaS client on LinkedIn, what CTA should I use?
say_en.note: Claude will provide personalized CTAs based on context.

say_en.text: This CTA isn't specific enough, try again.
say_en.note: Claude will regenerate CTAs meeting quality criteria.
